description: This file defines the 'AzureAppendBlobLogStorage' class, an internal implementation of IStateMachineStorage for Azure Blob Storage, providing append, delete, read, and replace operations for log storage using Azure Append Blob. It handles creation, appending blocks, reading streaming data, and managing snapshots.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobLogStorage
classes.description: Implements append-only log storage for Orleans using Azure Blob Storage's Append Blob feature, supporting appending, reading, replacing (via snapshot), and deleting blobs.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends a log extent to the blob storage, creating the blob if it doesn't exist, and updates internal state.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the blob and resets internal state, used for cleanup.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Streams the contents of the blob as log extents, restoring from snapshots if needed.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces the entire blob with new content, creating a snapshot beforehand for recovery.

methods.name: CopyFromSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Copies blob data from a snapshot URL back into the blob, used during recovery when the blob is empty.
